name: Mirage_Multimodal_Benchmark
description: A multimodal evaluation suite designed to assess models on combined image-and-text understanding tasks (e.g., VQA, captioning, and visual reasoning). It measures a model's ability to interpret visual inputs together with language and produce correct or fluent textual outputs. The benchmark aggregates multiple task formats to probe diverse multimodal capabilities.
reputation: An emerging multimodal benchmark on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among researchers working on vision–language models.
